sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: The HW17, Newell Highway Flood Mitigation West Wyalong to Forbes project requires a supplier to complete the Detailed Design Services and tender documentation for the 11Km of highway known as the Marsden area.
sections.heading: Project goals
Scope

sections.content:
This is an Early Notification only. Tender documents are not currently available.
Formal notification will occur when the RFT is published on the buy.NSW Tenders website.
Prospective Tenderers will be required to complete, sign and return a Confidentiality Deed Poll (CDP). Only Tenderer’s who have returned the CDP will be provided access to the RFT Suite of Documents upon release.
Transport for NSW reminds potential Tenderers that this is an 'expected' rather than 'actual' opportunity.
TfNSW reserves the right to not progress further in relation to procurement of HW17, Newell Highway Flood Mitigation West Wyalong to Forbes – Detailed Design Services if deemed necessary.
This early notification *must not be interpreted* to be confirmation that an actual procurement activity and/or RFT will occur for HW17, Newell Highway Flood Mitigation West Wyalong to Forbes – Detailed Design Services.
